test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six boxes M, N, O, P, Q and R are kept one above the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only 2 boxes are kept below M. Only one box is kept above Q. O is kept at any of the positions above R but not at the topmost position. R is not kept at the bottom most position. N is kept at any of the positions below Q. Where is box P kept?
solution:
Given: Six boxes M, N, O, P, Q, and R are kept one above the other.

1) Only 2 boxes are kept below M.

__ > __ > __ > M > __ > __

2) Only one box is kept above Q.

__ > Q > __ > M > __ > __

3) O is kept at any of the positions above R but not at the topmost position.

4) R is not kept at the bottommost position.

__ > Q > O > M > R > __

5) N is kept at any of the positions below Q.

__ > Q > O > M > R > N

So, P will be kept at the topmost position.

P > Q > O > M > R > N

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
